summary: YXT.com Group Holding Limited filed a Form 6-K with a press release announcing it regained compliance with Nasdaq's minimum bid price requirement. The company had received a deficiency notice on January 28, 2026, due to its ADSs trading below $1.00 for 30 consecutive business days. To regain compliance, it changed the ADS ratio from 1 ADS representing 3 ordinary shares to 1 ADS representing 30 ordinary shares, effective July 14, 2026. On July 30, 2026, Nasdaq confirmed the ADS closing bid price was at or above $1.00 for ten consecutive business days from July 16 to July 29, 2026, closing the matter.
